inbound_enquiry_handling.title: Inbound customer enquiries
inbound_enquiry_handling.claim: Woxza can answer incoming customer enquiries and keep the next step clear when that workflow is configured.

customer_follow_up_updates.title: Customer follow-up and updates
customer_follow_up_updates.claim: Woxza can be configured to keep customer follow-ups and updates moving, so they do not depend on someone remembering every call.

connected_system_workflows.title: Connected systems and workflows
connected_system_workflows.claim: Woxza can be configured to work with a business's connected systems, such as its CRM, calendar, messaging, or business data.

appointment_enquiries.title: Appointment enquiries
appointment_enquiries.claim: For an appointment-based business, Woxza can be configured to handle appointment enquiries and use a connected calendar where one is set up.
requirements: connected calendar when booking is needed

business_data_answers.title: Answers from connected business information
business_data_answers.claim: Once the right business information is connected, Woxza can answer from approved catalog, pricing, FAQ, or availability information instead of a generic script.

stock_aware_orders.title: Stock-aware order enquiries
stock_aware_orders.claim: When stock rules are connected, Woxza can receive order enquiries using the available quantity so a caller is not promised something the business cannot fulfil.

configured_business_rules.title: Configured business rules
configured_business_rules.claim: After a business sets its information, rules, and handoff choices, Woxza can handle those routine conversations consistently.

multilingual_customer_calls.title: Multilingual customer calls
multilingual_customer_calls.claim: Woxza can support customer conversations across the languages a business chooses for its workflow.
